description: OSM - Parkings automobiles gratuits à Roumois Seine is a dataset listed in Roumoiseine open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OSM France. Localisations des parkings automobiles gratuits à Roumois Seine. Coverage: Roumois Seine (Eure). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Mobilité, Transport urbain, Lieux de staionnements, Places de parkings. The portal shows 219 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roumoiseine-fr-portal.
